methods.name: collectRoutes
methods.description: Collects and returns the route group, enabling route collection within implementing classes.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds middleware (defined as a string, callable, or MiddlewareInterface) to the route group.

methods.name: addMiddleware
methods.description: Adds a MiddlewareInterface instance as middleware to the route group.

methods.name: appendMiddlewareToDispatcher
methods.description: Appends the route group's middleware to the given MiddlewareDispatcher.

methods.name: getPattern
methods.description: Retrieves the pattern associated with the route group.
